svg.title: Synthetic cohort distances under two declared comparison rules
svg.desc: A is the reference. B is a posed copy, C is 15 percent larger, D has a local bulge, and E has a changed cyclic starting index. Left: raw index RMS. Right: minimum RMS over proper rigid motions and cyclic shifts. Each panel uses its own labeled color scale in millimetres; compare numeric values, not shades across panels. Size differences remain.
